text.brief: A counterintelligence analyst at the FBI reads a transcript in September 2027 that should not exist. A senator's aide discussed Taiwan arms timing on an ordinary cell call, and the words now circulate on a foreign forum a week before a key vote.
text.record: CISA described the Salt Typhoon campaign against telecom networks worldwide in a joint advisory on August 27, 2025 ([CISA](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa25-239a)). An FBI official said in February 2026 that the threat remained "very, very much ongoing" and had reached more than 80 countries ([CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/fbi-salt-typhoon-ongoing-threat-cybertalks-2026/)). Treasury sanctioned a Sichuan firm tied to the campaign in January 2025 ([Treasury press release, January 17, 2025](https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy2792)).
text.reading: Access to carrier networks turns the lawful intercept system into a collection tool. The Party harvests the calls and texts of officials, staff and campaigns, then spends a few pieces when a vote or an election makes them useful. This is Stratagem 12, take the opportunity to pilfer a goat.
text.coreEvent: American officials confirm that the Party's hackers still hold access to at least one major American carrier's network during 2027.
text.gapText: Technology Architecture. The intercept systems built for courts gave the intruder a door into every call.
text.fix: Encrypt official communications end to end and treat every intercept system as a target that must prove its integrity.
